open_source.title: Open source
open_source.body: Anyone can read Lukitas's code: nothing in it is hidden. It's free software, licensed under the AGPL-3.0.

what.a: An app for your monthly budget that doesn't feel like homework. You log what you spend, see what's left in each category, and Lukitas, a gold coin with plenty of personality, keeps you company: it cheers when you log something and gives you a heads-up when a category is filling up.

import.q: Can I bring my history from other apps?
import.a: Yes. Today you can import from Budge: export your transactions as a CSV and upload it when you sign up or later from Settings. Buddy and other apps are coming soon. Before anything is imported you see a preview: how many transactions come in, which ones are duplicates and which categories will be created.

passwords.q: Why doesn't it ask for a password?
passwords.a: Because you don't need one. You sign in with a 6-digit code or a link sent to your email and, if you like, with a passkey: your fingerprint, your face or your phone's screen lock. No password to remember.

privacy.q: What do you do with my data?
privacy.a: Your data travels encrypted, and we never sell it or share it with advertisers. You can export it or delete your account whenever you want. And since the code is open source, anyone can check what we do with it.

free.a: Yes, and it always will be. Lukitas is free and open source: all the code is on <github>GitHub</github> for anyone to read. We never ask for a card.

languages.a: Spanish and English. Switch whenever you like in Settings, and amounts and dates follow your language's format.
